# Seattle Tulip Hideaway

> Seattle Tulip Hideaway is a spacious 1,000 sq ft garden suite at 2124 31st Ave S, Seattle, WA 98144, in the Mount Baker neighborhood, beneath a 150-year-old tulip tree and about a 5-minute walk to Lake Washington. It sleeps up to 6 guests and is booked through Airbnb. Seattle short-term rental license STR-OPLI-22-001317.

## The suite

- Sleeps 6: a king bed in the bedroom, a queen fold-out bed, and a double fold-out futon; 1 bathroom with a tub
- Two living areas, HDTV with Chromecast, board games, and books
- Full kitchen with stove, oven, dishwasher, microwave, full-size refrigerator, coffee maker, blender, and rice maker
- Free in-unit washer and dryer, dedicated workspace with a monitor, and wifi
- Pack 'n play (on request), high chair, and children's dinnerware
- Radiant heating and portable fans (no air conditioning)
- A 150-year-old tulip tree on the property
- Private entrance through the garden, a shared fenced backyard, and free parking

## Nearby

- Lake Washington, about a 5-minute walk; Colman Park and Mount Baker Park are closer
- Mount Baker Beach (pier, swimming, summer lifeguards) and Mount Baker Park's playground, each half a mile away
- Mount Baker and Judkins Park light rail stations, each under a mile away

## House rules

- Check-in after 3:00 PM (self check-in with smart lock); checkout before 11:00 AM
- 6 guests maximum; up to 2 pets allowed (the host's dogs use the shared backyard)
- No parties, events, or smoking; quiet hours 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM
